notes.title: Update 2018/10/24
notes.notes:
Fixed that terrible jump issue. Also:
- quick fix for AZERTY support (will redo the whole input system later)
- pandas don't teleport to the start with you if you lose a life
- collisions better for player character now (still having issues with NPCs though)
- menu should remember options from now on

Currently stuck on the AI and scoreboard. Gonna focus more on those this week. Sorry I actually still have no idea what this game is about.

(This update went up late on Sunday but I couldn't write it up until now)

notes.title: Update 2018/10/15
notes.notes:
Uploaded a newer version with a few fixes including:

- directional arrow, and only one searchable panda at a time cause the old system was dumb and discouraged exploring.
- mouse sensitivity slider to help with the camera issues.
- started work on collision issues just a little, but it's still pretty buggy.

Still to do: jump issue, enemy spawn rate, AI, general gameplay design issues, missing models and sound effects ect.

I'll see what else I can do before the end of the week and do another update then.

notes.title: Release
notes.notes: Still a lot to fix and improve on but it's at least playable in its current state.
